name: coach-core-e2e
description: Real-browser tests of the Coach Core web app against the local Firebase Emulator Suite (demo-* project). Never runs against a real Firebase project.

scripts.test: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-coach-core-e2e --only auth,firestore,functions "npm --prefix e2e run test:browser"
scripts.test:auth-only: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-coach-core-e2e --only auth "E2E_AUTH_ONLY=1 npm --prefix e2e run test:browser"
